jdf.export_label: CIS JŘ bus JDF export of 20 Oct 2026 (stored by the Havířov/Karviná/Orlová pipeline)
jdf.why: The kraj numbers each contract area's licences with its own prefix: 912 Havířovsko (I and II), 873 Karvinsko, 874 Orlovsko (871 Českotěšínsko, 863 Frýdecko-Místecko, 904 Hlučínsko). Checked against the live map: the 912 lines run from provozovna Havířov with 42-/43- buses, 873 from Karviná with 52-, 874 from Orlová with 51-; the register notes name the same areas ('provozní oblast Karvinsko' …). The ODIS line number is the last three digits; one ODIS line can hold licences of two areas (553: 873553 + 874553), so trips are merged by ODIS number.

terminus_alias_why: Buses arrive at Havířov, Podlesí, autobusové nádraží and leave from Podlesí, Těšínská, 2 min away (the Havířov/Karviná/Orlová sheet's alias): one terminus.

regular_not_diversion.873582: The diversion of 582 (28 Aug – 30 Nov 2026: Stonava, Důl ČSM-Jih, Důl ČSM-Sever, Hořany and Mexico not served) ends in six weeks, so the regular route is modelled (shared rule: short-term closures as the regular state).

365.note: Frýdek-Místek – Havířov via Dobrá, Horní and Dolní Domaslavice, Soběšovice and Žermanice: 9 stops no other line serves. It runs only about every 80–90 min, at no fixed minute: from Frýdek-Místek 13:40 (to Žermanice), 15:00, 16:30, 17:50; back 14:05, 15:00, 16:45, 17:24. Every 90 hits 15:00 and 16:30 exactly both ways. The rest are 10–35 min off and listed. The buses rotate between 365–369 at both ends.

366.note: Frýdek-Místek – Havířov via Dobrá, Lučina and Žermanice. About hourly, but at no fixed minute (out 13:20, 14:30, 15:10, 16:10, 16:58). The line is read at Žermanice, rozcestí, so the short trips that turn there count. Towards Frýdek-Místek the buses pass Žermanice at :36 (12:36, 16:36), so Podlesí departs :25. Approximate.

367.note: Frýdek-Místek – Havířov via Sedliště, Bruzovice and Žermanice: 3 trips each way in the afternoon. Every 180 with one bus: Frýdek-Místek 16:35 exact (the 13:35 slot stands for 13:25), Podlesí 15:40 exact. The way back runs on the Lučina path (Bruzovice, Zámostí – Pazderna – Lučina), as the evening trips do, so Zámostí, which only those serve, is on a line.

368.note: Frýdek-Místek – Havířov via Sedliště, direct: 3 trips a day each way, 170–180 min apart in the afternoon. Every 180 with one bus: Frýdek-Místek :40 (12:40 exact; 15:30 is 10 min early), Podlesí 13:35 and 16:35 exact (16:35 is the 16:22 trip from Havířov, Město passing Podlesí, Těšínská). It is the only line at Bruzovice, Kunčický and Bruzovice, kříž.

369.note: Frýdek-Místek – Havířov via Sedliště, Kaňovice and Šenov. Hourly all day at its core points: Frýdek-Místek :30, and towards Frýdek-Místek Havířov, Město, železniční stanice :57 (8:57–18:57). Half the trips end at Město, the rest go on to Podlesí, so the Simutrans line runs to Podlesí. It leaves Podlesí at :45, to pass Město at :57. In the afternoon 14:45 and 15:40 (back 14:22, 14:52, 15:52) are shifted, and listed.

443.note: Havířov – Ostrava, Náměstí Republiky (express). Exactly hourly 13:01–18:01: Podlesí :01, Náměstí Republiky :40. The morning every-30 service and the evening trips from Těšínská are listed.

445.note: Havířov – Ostrava, Poruba via Zábřeh, AVION: about hourly 14:00–17:00 (Podlesí 14:12, 15:12, 16:47; Poruba 14:14, 15:32, 16:32). Every 60 at :12 / :32, approximate. All its Ostrava stops are DPO stops as well.

448.note: Havířov – Ostrava, Hrabůvka via Vratimov. Hourly: Podlesí :05 (12:05–17:03), Poliklinika :50. The 13:03 and 17:03 trips and their returns 14:00 and 18:05 run via Kartonážka and Hrabová, průmyslová zóna (DPO lines serve those stops). The line runs the direct path.

sim.name: 451 Elektrárna
sim.why: Podlesí 12:45 (real 13:00): 13:00 is a departure of the every-30 trunk, so the shift bus leaves between two trunk departures instead of with one.

451.note: Havířov – Orlová, Lutyně, every 30 all day: Podlesí :00 / :30, Lutyně :16 / :46 (:18 / :48 after 17:00). It is modelled at 16:00. 13:00–15:00 has extra shift trips (13:08, 13:20, 13:45, 14:15, 14:35); they are listed. Trips via Orlová, Město, náměstí run in the same slots, and that stop is on the town lines. The Elektrárna Dětmarovice trips are the power plant's shifts, so they become 451 Elektrárna, every 480: Elektrárna 14:10 (22:10, 6:10), Podlesí 12:45 (20:45, 4:45): the real 13:00 is a slot of the every-30 trunk, so the shift bus leaves 15 min earlier rather than together with a trunk bus. It is the only service of Dětmarovice, V polích.

453.note: Havířov – Bohumín, Pudlov (the ŽDB works). A shift line, exactly every 480: Podlesí 4:45, 12:45, 20:45; Pudlov 6:18, 14:18, 22:16. In the afternoon it is the only line at Pudlov, drátovny and ŽD točna. The 16:10 and 18:05 trips via Nový Bohumín are listed.

452.note: Havířov – Orlová via Prostřední Suchá and Dolní Suchá: 4 trips each way in the afternoon at irregular times (Podlesí 12:45, 14:35, 17:00, 18:20; Lutyně 13:50, 14:40, 15:35, 16:48). Every 60 at :45 / :48, approximate.

460.note: Orlová – Nošovice, Hyundai. A shift line, exactly every 480: Lutyně 4:30, 12:30, 20:30; Hyundai 6:25, 14:25, 22:25. It is the only line at Frýdek, Povodí Odry and Nošovice, PZ – sever.

465.note: Havířov – Třanovice via Žermanice, Soběšovice and Dolní Domaslavice: 8 stops no other line serves. Hourly 13:00–16:00 (Třanovice :16, Podlesí :40), then only in the evening. Every 60, approximate on the Havířov side.

533.note: Karviná – Havířov via Doly and Horní Suchá. Karviná :08 all day, every 30 (:08 / :38) from 13:38 to 16:38. Podlesí :45 in the morning, then :05 / :40 from 14:40 to 17:05; the :40 trips take the shorter path without Doly, Barbora. Modelled at 16:00 as one line with two slots each way, on the full path.

583.note: Karviná – Havířov via Stonava, Holkovice. Hourly: Karviná :21 to Havířov, Město, nemocnice; back from Havířov, Město, železniční stanice :22, which passes nemocnice at :31. So nemocnice is the terminal. The morning and evening trips to and from Podlesí (Karviná :38, Podlesí :15 / :20) are listed; Podlesí is on 533.

532.note: Karviná – Ostrava, Náměstí Republiky (express). Náměstí Republiky :39, hourly 13:39–18:39 (exact). Karviná is irregular (12:23, 12:53, 13:28, 14:28, 15:20, 16:20, 16:51): every 60 at :20. The timetable valid on the day is a diversion version (1 Aug – 12 Dec), with the same stops.

537.note: Karviná – Petrovice, Závada. One bus, hourly: Karviná :37, Závada :05. From 14:37 the buses go on to Dětmarovice, železniční stanice (and come in from Orlová, Lutyně, věžáky), passing Závada at :21 on the way back. Those extensions serve stops of other lines and are listed.

538.note: Karviná – Petrovice, Prstná. Prstná :08 hourly all day (exact). Karviná :29 on the :29 trips' longer path, or :35 / :40. Every 60 at :29 / :08.

553.note: Ostrava, hlavní nádraží – Orlová – Karviná: two licences of one line (873553 Karvinsko, 874553 Orlovsko), merged. Read at Lutyně (core point): Ostrava :32 to Karviná (8:32–16:32), and Lutyně :21 towards Ostrava (Karviná :53), hourly and exact. The extra Ostrava – Orlová trips (14:52, 15:52, then :02) are 553 Orlová, with an empty return, because their real buses go on as other lines. The Rychvald, Autopal shift trips (Lutyně 5:17, 13:17, 21:17, exactly every 480) are 553 Autopal. It is the only service of Autopal.

581.note: Karviná – Albrechtice. Exactly hourly: Karviná :10, Albrechtice :00. 2 buses, as in reality.

sim.why: Every 480 with seven hourly slots: the eighth hour (12:40 from Karviná) is 582 ČSM's, so the two never leave together (Ex4).

582.note: Karviná – Horní Suchá via Stonava and Albrechtice: Karviná :40 hourly (exact 12:40–16:40), written as every 480 with seven slots, because 12:40 (20:40, 4:40) is 582 ČSM's (Ex4). The 28 Aug – 30 Nov diversion, which skips the Stonava mines, is left out: the regular route is modelled. Its shift trips via the Stonava mines and Mexico (Karviná 12:40 and 20:40, Horní Suchá 14:00) are 582 ČSM, every 480. It is the only service of Stonava, Mexico. Back from Horní Suchá is irregular (14:00, 15:30, 16:28).

543.note: Ostrava, hlavní nádraží – Dětmarovice via Rychvald and Dolní Lutyně. Ostrava :12 hourly 13:12–16:12, but back from Dětmarovice only every 2 h (13:04, 15:04; morning 5:04, 7:04). The plates show how: the 14:12 bus comes back as the 15:04, while the 13:12 and 15:12 buses go on from Dětmarovice as 546 short trips to Bohumín (51-1107 at 13:57, 51-1105 at 15:57). So 543 runs every 120 both ways (Ostrava 14:12, 16:12; Dětmarovice 13:04, 15:04), one bus, and 543B runs Ostrava 13:12, 15:12 out with an empty return.

546.note: Karviná – Bohumín via Dětmarovice and Dolní Lutyně. Every 2 h: Karviná 14:25, 16:15, 18:15; Nový Bohumín 16:52 (to Dětmarovice), 18:52. Every 120, to Nový Bohumín, autobusová stanice, which all trips pass. The Pudlov trips (12:30, 14:30) are covered by 453. The Dětmarovice – Bohumín short trips are listed.

552.note: Orlová – Ostrava, Náměstí Republiky (express). A midday line that ends at 15:35: Lutyně :30 (5:30–13:30 exact), Ostrava :35. The diversion timetable is valid all autumn and keeps the same stops.

558.note: Orlová – Bohumín via Petřvald and Rychvald: Lutyně :02 hourly (9 of 11 exact). Back from Nový Bohumín, železniční stanice: :04 in the morning, :16 late in the afternoon (15:16, 17:16, 18:16). The Pudlov trip at 14:40 (6:54 in the morning) is 558 Pudlov, every 480 with an empty return. It is the only line at Pudlov, střed.

559.note: Orlová – Bohumín via Dolní Lutyně, at irregular times (Lutyně 13:00, 14:00, 15:15, 16:55, 19:00; Bohumín 14:05, 14:30, 15:40, 16:50, 17:20, 18:50). The Kovošrot shift trips (Lutyně 13:00, 21:05; Bohumín 6:30, 14:30, 22:36) are 559 Kovošrot, every 480. It is the only service of Kovošrot.

560.note: Orlová – Bohumín via Dolní Lutyně, on 559's other path. Irregular; every 60 at :40 / :00, approximate.

563.note: Orlová – the Stonava mines via Karviná, Doly. A shift line every 480: Lutyně 4:45, 12:45, 20:45; Důl ČSM-Jih 6:15, 14:07, 22:10. It is the only line at Karviná, Doly, Důl ČSA.

565.note: Dolní Lutyně, Věřňovice – Bohumín via Kopytov and Šunychl. One bus runs it about every 90 min (Bohumín 14:35, 16:10; Věřňovice 15:15, 16:45), so the line is every 90. The Nový Bohumín – Kopytov short trips through Vrchlického (13:10, 14:05) are 565 Kopytov, every 480. It is the only service of Vrchlického.

network_state: The CIS JŘ export has diversion versions of 532 and 552 valid 1 Aug – 12 Dec 2026, with the same stops as the regular ones. They run on the vehicle day until the end of the timetable year, so they are modelled as they run.
Line 582: Stonava mines diversion (28 Aug – 30 Nov)
The diversion skips Stonava, Důl ČSM-Jih, Důl ČSM-Sever, Hořany and Mexico. It ends in six weeks, so the regular route is modelled (shared rule: short works as the regular state).

Havířovsko (licences 912xxx: Havířovsko I and II), Karvinsko (873xxx) and Orlovsko (874xxx), Transdev Slezsko. The kraj gives each area its own licence prefix. 553 holds a licence in both Karvinsko and Orlovsko and is one line here.
These lines of the same areas stop at Ostrava, Hranečník and are on the Ostrava sheet (section All lines at Hranečník), with their buses. They are not repeated here.

pak.why: Pak session f3, 20 Oct 2026: VZ-ODIS-bus holds the ODIS regional fleet; every regional line uses it. Transdev Slezsko's 3ČSAD white-green is 3csadbilozelena, white with the kraj logo is bilazelenykruh (the green ring of Havířovsko), and 43-1101 and 43-1112 have a bright green CNG pod (3csadbilozelenazelenybox).
